customers.evidence: The promise of surprises, fun, ease and inspiration at every turn, no matter when, where or how you shop.

employees.evidence: It gets our teams excited to come to work each day.

community.evidence: We’re dedicated to being a good neighbor and working with our communities and partners to make life a little better everywhere we do business.

shareholders.evidence: Our durable business model is designed to stand the test of time and differentiate us in the marketplace.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice that leads with customer joy and surprise rather than factual metrics. Purpose is stated absolutely ('That's our purpose'), while community commitments are framed as dedication to being a good neighbor. Financial, governance, safety and ethics content is absent; history and workforce facts are presented as business description.
